sources.facts: The theatre operator identifies the front as two storeys of Japanese-style brick and the rear as three storeys, containing the experimental theatre, offices and rehearsal space.
Taipei Department of Cultural Affairs documents restoration and the Art Deco corner elevations, and the historic police station conversion. Restoration completed in 2020.
2014 Taipei gazette registers the former Zhongzheng Second Precinct building as a historic structure and describes the downtown corner elevations.
A 2020 Taipei City report describes the corner building as gray-white after restoration. Historical shaping and window color follow the cleared original photograph.
